{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Check all unique revenue values
all_revenue_values = df['revenue'].unique()
print("All unique revenue values:", all_revenue_values)

# Check if there are any values like '999999.99' or similar
print("Rows where revenue == '999999.99':")
print(df[df['revenue'] == '999999.99'])

# Check for any revenue values that might be formatted differently (e.g., with commas)
# Look for any non-numeric strings
print("Rows with non-standard revenue formatting (e.g., commas):")
print(df[df['revenue'].str.contains(',', na=False)])"}
